segments.snp4.6:1.1: Appaṃ vata jīvitaṃ idaṃ, oraṃ vassasatāpi miyyati [mīyati (sī. aṭṭha.)];
segments.snp4.6:1.3: Yo cepi aticca jīvati, atha kho so jarasāpi miyyati.
segments.snp4.6:2.1: Socanti janā mamāyite, na hi santi [na hi santā (sī.), na hī santi (katthaci)] niccā pariggahā;
segments.snp4.6:3.1: Maraṇenapi taṃ pahīyati [pahiyyati (sī. syā. ka.)], yaṃ puriso mamidanti [mamayidanti (sī. syā. ka.), mamāyanti (ka.)] maññati;
segments.snp4.6:3.3: Etampi viditvā [etaṃ disvāna (niddese), etampi viditva (?)] paṇḍito, na mamattāya nametha māmako.
segments.snp4.6:4.1: Supinena yathāpi saṅgataṃ, paṭibuddho puriso na passati;
segments.snp4.6:4.3: Evampi piyāyitaṃ janaṃ, petaṃ kālakataṃ na passati.
segments.snp4.6:5.1: Diṭṭhāpi sutāpi te janā, yesaṃ nāmamidaṃ pavuccati [nāmamevā vasissati (sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.snp4.6:6.1: Sokapparidevamaccharaṃ [sokaparidevamaccharaṃ (sī. syā. pī.), sokaṃ paridevamaccharaṃ (?)], na jahanti giddhā mamāyite;
segments.snp4.6:6.3: Tasmā munayo pariggahaṃ, hitvā acariṃsu khemadassino.
segments.snp4.6:7.3: Sāmaggiyamāhu tassa taṃ, yo attānaṃ bhavane na dassaye.
segments.snp4.6:8.1: Sabbattha munī anissito, na piyaṃ kubbati nopi appiyaṃ;
segments.snp4.6:8.3: Tasmiṃ paridevamaccharaṃ, paṇṇe vāri yathā na limpati [lippati (sī. pī.)].
segments.snp4.6:9.1: Udabindu yathāpi pokkhare, padume vāri yathā na limpati;
segments.snp4.6:9.3: Evaṃ muni nopalimpati, yadidaṃ diṭṭhasutaṃ mutesu vā.
segments.snp4.6:10.1: Dhono na hi tena maññati, yadidaṃ diṭṭhasutaṃ mutesu vā;
segments.snp4.6:10.3: Nāññena visuddhimicchati, na hi so rajjati no virajjatīti.

lines: 812-6. Mamāyiteti mamāyitavatthukāraṇā.
Vinābhāvasantamevidanti santavinābhāvaṃ vijjamānavinābhāvameva idaṃ, na sakkā avinābhāvena bhavitunti vuttaṃ hoti.
Māmakoti mama upāsako bhikkhu vāti saṅkhaṃ gato, buddhādīni vā vatthūni mamāyamāno.
Saṅgatanti samāgataṃ diṭṭhapubbaṃ vā.
Piyāyitanti piyaṃ kataṃ.
Nāmaṃyevāvasissati akkheyyanti sabbaṃ rūpādidhammajātaṃ pahīyati, nāmamattameva tu avasissati “buddharakkhito, dhammarakkhito”ti evaṃ saṅkhātuṃ kathetuṃ.
Munayoti khīṇāsavamunayo.
Khemadassinoti nibbānadassino.
Sattamagāthā evaṃ maraṇabbhāhate loke anurūpapaṭipattidassanatthaṃ vuttā.
Tattha patilīnacarassāti tato tato patilīnaṃ cittaṃ katvā carantassa.
Bhikkhunoti kalyāṇaputhujjanassa sekkhassa vā.
Sāmaggiyamāhu tassa taṃ, yo attānaṃ bhavane na dassayeti tassetaṃ patirūpamāhu, yo evaṃpaṭipanno nirayādibhede bhavane attānaṃ na dasseyya.
Evañhi so imamhā maraṇā mucceyyāti adhippāyo.
818-20. Idāni yo “attānaṃ bhavane na dassaye”ti evaṃ khīṇāsavo vibhāvito, tassa vaṇṇabhaṇanatthaṃ ito parā tisso gāthāyo āha.
Tattha sabbatthāti dvādasasu āyatanesu.
Yadidaṃ diṭṭhasutaṃ mutesu vāti ettha pana yadidaṃ diṭṭhasutaṃ, ettha vā mutesu vā dhammesu evaṃ muni na upalimpatīti evaṃ sambandho veditabbo.
Dhono na hi tena maññati, yadidaṃ diṭṭhasutaṃ mutesu vāti atrāpi yadidaṃ diṭṭhasuttaṃ, tena vatthunā na maññati, mutesu vā dhammesu na maññatīti evameva sambandho veditabbo.
Na hi so rajjati no virajjatīti.
Bālaputhujjanā viya na rajjati, kalyāṇaputhujjanasekkhā viya na virajjati, rāgassa pana khīṇattā “virāgo” tveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
Sesaṃ sabbattha pākaṭamevāti.
Desanāpariyosāne caturāsītiyā pāṇasahassānaṃ dhammābhisamayo ahosīti.
